NOTICE

This directory contains code from the EDM project developed by NVIDIA Corporation.

Original Work:
  Title: Elucidating the Design Space of Diffusion-Based Generative Models (EDM)
  Authors: Tero Karras, Miika Aittala, Timo Aila, Samuli Laine
  Source: https://github.com/NVlabs/edm
  License: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

The following components are included:
- dnnlib: Utility library for deep learning
- torch_utils: PyTorch utilities including persistence module

These components are used for loading and working with pretrained EDM models
for image denoising tasks.

No modifications have been made to the original code.

Citation:
  @inproceedings{Karras2022edm,
    title={Elucidating the Design Space of Diffusion-Based Generative Models},
    author={Tero Karras and Miika Aittala and Timo Aila and Samuli Laine},
    booktitle={Proc. NeurIPS},
    year={2022}
  }
